facts.statement: The Community Team held a New Year 2011 kickoff party as the first major community event of the year, on Server 1 at the Snow Hill stage.
facts.quote: ¡Es hora de nuestro primer gran evento comunitario del año!

facts.statement: The US and Latin America session was Thursday 6 January 2011 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jueves 6 de Enero del 2011 3pm Tiempo del Pacifico (EE. UU. y America Latina) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session was Friday 7 January 2011 at 9am Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Viernes 7 de Enero del 2011 9am Tiempo del Pacifico (Reino Unido y Europa) Servidor 1

facts.statement: Players were invited to bring their favorite outfits and boomboxes to the party.
facts.quote: Trae tus trajes favoritos y tus radio caseteras.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta de Inicio al 2011 (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice announcing the first community party of 2011, held weekly on Thursdays at a different location, with the Snow Hill stage on Server 1 as the venue. It gives two session times: one for US and Latin America and one for UK and Europe, both on Server 1. The page's 'posted 4 months, 4 weeks ago' label conflicts with the January 2011 event dates, so the posting date is uncertain.
